summary: Saint Louis County, MN fire lookout marked gone by the Fire Lookout Association; no history or removal date found in the sources read.

facts.status_note: Fire Lookout Association lists it as gone; no removal date or other dated record was found

evidence.supports: Wood Duck is in Saint Louis County at 48.16818, -93.0965 and marked gone on the association's county list
evidence.quote: Saint Louis Wood Duck 48.16818 -93.09650 Tower Gone

notes_for_editor: Thinnest of the three records: two list entries only. The association's county list gives the coordinates and the gone status; the Forest Lookouts Minnesota page gives only the county heading. Two web searches and the sources read found no history, build date, height, staffing or removal date. The story is about 70 words, below the usual 120-word length, because nothing more is sourced; expand it only if a dated source turns up. No source read confirms that the tower lies in the Superior National Forest. A Star Tribune article on removed Minnesota towers was rate-limited (HTTP 429) and not read; it may cover this tower. The coordinates were not checked on a map.
